title: 游戏业数千岗位消失：GTA6却靠人工细节卖爆，玩家用观看和聆听投票？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get more now on GTA 6, joining us as Gordon Bellamy, director of ethics at the University of Southern California's School of Cinematic Arts.
segments.zh: 接下来聊聊《GTA 6》，嘉宾是南加州大学电影艺术学院伦理主任戈登·贝拉米。

segments.en: Gordon, thank you so much for joining. What is rockstar and specifically in this GTA 6 doing right?
segments.zh: 戈登，感谢参与。Rockstar 尤其是《GTA 6》做对了什么？

segments.en: Because on the one hand, you're seeing huge success here, and it looks like the video gaming industry is so successful, but we know that so many studios have closed down not just this year,
segments.zh: 一方面，成功巨大，游戏行业看似繁荣，但许多工作室关闭，不仅今年，

segments.en: but last year, two thousands of jobs gone out of the industry. What they're doing right is they put a person behind every corner of the biggest entertainment moment
segments.zh: 去年也有数千岗位消失。他们做对的是在游戏史上最大娱乐时刻的每个角落都有人。

segments.en: in gaming history, and so people are able to enjoy this game by playing, by watching, by listening. It's really an incredible moment and players feel it.
segments.zh: 人们通过玩、看、听享受游戏。这真是不可思议的时刻，玩家能感受到。

segments.en: So Gordon, just give us a sense of context here for the gaming business.
segments.zh: 戈登，请给我们讲讲游戏行业的背景。

segments.en: How big is it in the context of overall entertainment?
segments.zh: 在整体娱乐中规模多大？

segments.en: Because the numbers just kind of blow me away when I hear them. Sure. What they did uniquely is they got everyone to show up in one day in so many different ways.
segments.zh: 数字让我震惊。他们独特的是让所有人同一天以多种方式参与。

segments.en: So of course, you've seen the revenue that was generated by people buying the game, but it's also huge on Spotify. It's the biggest new music channel on Spotify right now.
segments.zh: 当然有购买游戏的收入，在 Spotify 上也巨大，是最大新音乐频道。

segments.en: It's the biggest channels on Twitch where people are just watching. So people are watching, people are listening, people are playing, people are engaging with it in so many ways.
segments.zh: 是 Twitch 上最大频道之一，人们观看、聆听、游玩，以多种方式参与。
